Cannot be fully described even by the Victors and their heirs
Residing in the ten directions; nevertheless,
Listen briefly to what I offer with faith.

The profound meaning of the scriptures of the Perfection of Wisdom,
You listened to continuously, O Bodhisattva Lord of Dharma.

Please cause the innate primordial wisdom of great bliss to arise.
Please dispel the stains of the delusion of reifying things as real.
Please cut through the web of doubt regarding the nature of mind.
Swiftly bless me to become just like you.

Please bestow the supreme and common accomplishments.
Swiftly bless me to become just like you.
I offer clouds of Samantabhadra’s offerings, equal to the sky.
